llm.guidance: This is an instruction-only pension/advice helper and appears internally consistent. Before using: do not provide account credentials, private statements, or upload sensitive financial files unless you trust the destination; the SKILL.md mentions live syncing but does not declare how that happens — if a future version asks for API keys or banking credentials, treat that as a significant escalation and review where data will be sent. Prefer using anonymized or synthetic data for testing, and ask the skill author for clarification if automatic syncing or external data sources are required.
